top_signals.title: Don’t hike bank taxes, Barclays warns Burnham
top_signals.summary: Barclays has warned Andy Burnham not to slap fresh taxes on banks, as fears grow the new prime minister could take advantage of lenders’ bumper earnings to launch a raid on the sector. Speaking after Barclays’ half year results this morning, executives warned that banks already faced the highest rates of tax globally and saddling [...]

top_signals.title: Centene Slides On Dimming Outlook For Medicaid Profit Margins
top_signals.summary: Centene Corp. shares fell after the health insurer said it would take longer than planned to rebuild profits in its Medicaid business, a worrying sign that overshadowed an upbeat earnings report.

top_signals.title: Most Stocks Rise as Earnings Outweigh Chip Rout: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders kept driving a rotation out of high-profile chipmakers and into a broader category of companies tuned to improving growth prospects, with most stocks rising amid strong corporate earnings.

top_signals.title: First Brands Bankruptcy: Lawsuits Around Alleged Fraud Seek to Recoup Billions
top_signals.summary: The pitch to creditors of bankrupt First Brands goes like this: Stick with us just a while longer, and you’ll get a full recovery as we claw back $2 billion from suing a long list of insiders and business partners who allegedly perpetrated a widespread fraud.

top_signals.title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
top_signals.summary: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.
